column1: # Every network command a workflow step or a composite action runs outside .github/scripts/ci-log-guard.sh, in its
# run: or in a shell script it runs, with the reason it is not guarded: .github/scripts/check-log-guard.sh refuses a
# command no row names, and a row no command matches. Tab-separated: file, job (`-` for a composite action), step,
# client, reason; a script's row names the script, then `-` and `-`.
# cybermonklabs/legion#2918 (every download retries) changes many of these steps and scripts, which keep main's text
# here until it merges, so the two do not conflict. Its .github/scripts/ci-retry.sh's retry_fetch runs each attempt
# inside a ci-log-guard.sh block of its own. A reason says what #2918 does with its row's commands: a row whose every
# command #2918 runs through retry_fetch goes when #2918 merges, and a row with a command #2918 leaves with no block
